author: SpeakerJohnson
text:
The tragic passing of Jim Copenhaver is now the second victim of the horrific assassination attempt on President Trump in Butler, Pennsylvania.

Our nation will not forget his perseverance and what he suffered. 

We pray for his family and ask God to provide them comfort, strength, and peace during this very difficult time. https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/6110269-trump-rally-shooting-victim-dies/amp/
